page.layout: One block of running text in two columns, the upper part above the stamp area and the lower part below it, with the text ending around the middle of the page. Small marginal notes in the left margin beside the upper text. Running head at the top right. Library stamp in the centre, not transcribed.
page.notes: The scan is very faint and low in contrast. Almost all of the body text, the marginal notes and the running head cannot be read letter by letter, so the placeholders above stand in for them and the exact line breaks and paragraph divisions are uncertain. The top-right running head and page number look like a small printed heading and a number, but I cannot confirm them, hence the [?] marks. The left-margin notes are small and cannot be read. The library stamp (Stadtbibliothek Zürich) was left out. The lower block of lines near the foot of the text may hold a closing line or signature, but it is not legible enough to copy.
